httpx-0276ff9880.request: When a redirect changes the request method from POST to GET, the Content-Length header from the original request shouldn't be carried over to the new GET request.

httpx-2129a9789a.request: When sending file-like or iterable content in a request body, can we avoid `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` when the content's total length can actually be determined upfront (e.g. from a real file or a seekable stream), and use `Content-Length` instead in those cases?

httpx-7fea0723e2.request: When establishing a TLS connection, the SSL context should be built using the actual negotiated protocol/ALPN settings for that connection instead of a generic loader, so the right protocol identifiers get used.

httpx-b4b27ff677.request: The `curio` async library branch in our timer utility never gets exercised and adds dead code. Can you remove that unused check so we only support asyncio and trio?

httpx-1ce3cc3269.request: Add docstrings to the request functions and client so that help() and API doc generators show usage, parameters, and return types for each request method.

httpx-ea137a96d9.request: The `delete()` request helper is missing `params` and `headers` options — a previous change accidentally dropped them and left `data`/`files` instead, which don't make sense for a DELETE call. Can you restore the ability to pass query params and headers to `delete()`?

httpx-40849bffcb.request: URLs with internationalized domain names in the host aren't encoding correctly against the current IDNA spec—some Unicode hostnames (including ones using deprecated mappings) end up producing the wrong punycode or failing to normalize. Can we fix URL parsing so it correctly IDNA-encodes Unicode hostnames per the 2008 spec across scheme, host, and port?

httpx-27b0dbc22d.request: When `raise_for_status()` triggers on a 4xx or 5xx response, it should raise a more specific exception type for status errors instead of the generic HTTP error, so callers can distinguish status errors from other HTTP failures while still catching them as HTTP errors.

httpx-a226c60861.request: HEAD requests and client `head()` calls don't follow redirects by default, unlike other HTTP methods. Please make `allow_redirects` default to true for these too, for consistency.

httpx-80eafe89c2.request: When the ASGI app dispatcher spawns the app coroutine as a background task, it should use the same context-managed background task abstraction as the other dispatchers instead of grabbing the event loop directly and calling create_task, so custom concurrency backends can eventually be supported there too.

httpx-81f385c484.request: The `stream()` function doesn't apply the `timeout` argument to the client it creates, so timeouts passed to `stream()` are silently ignored. Please make it actually respect the given timeout.

httpx-d7aa6e0189.request: I need a way to catch both request errors and HTTP status errors from a response in a single except block, since right now they don't share a common base exception. Can you add a shared base class so `try/except` around a request plus `.raise_for_status()` only needs one exception type?

httpx-78afd08e0f.request: When an async response is closed, the underlying stream isn't actually being closed because the code checks for the wrong attribute — it should detect the stream's async close method properly so it gets closed as expected.

httpx-23f11aaa8d.request: Clean up the client-error and server-error status checks so the range comparisons read as a single chained comparison instead of two separate conditions.

httpx-ba2e51215e.request: Query params with spaces should be encoded using "+" like a browser form submit, not "%20", and slashes in query values shouldn't be escaped either. Also double-check the set of characters we treat as safe when percent-encoding is correct.

httpx-49d74a2e7f.request: When a header value that isn't a string or bytes (like None) is passed in, raise a clear error explaining that header values must be str or bytes, instead of failing with a confusing error later.

httpx-2f0e0480da.request: Basic auth is adding a trailing newline/whitespace strip to the base64-encoded credentials before building the `Basic` header — the encoded token shouldn't be stripped since base64 output from these calls never has extra whitespace to remove.

httpx-db7f2d0df3.request: Add support for reading the SSLKEYLOGFILE environment variable so TLS session keys can be logged for debugging with tools like Wireshark, but only when the client is trusting environment settings.

ripgrep-f2f3d00df7.request: The rg completion menu doesn't let me filter/narrow the suggested type or color-spec names by typing — can you make it support removing already-typed prefixes as I refine my selection, like completion menus usually do?

ripgrep-15b263ff55.request: Add "cs" as a recognized filetype alias for C# files (matching *.cs), so it's quicker to type than "csharp".

ripgrep-020c5453a5.request: When stdin is piped from Powershell on a Unix-like system, the tool doesn't detect that data is available—readable stdin should also recognize sockets, not just regular files and FIFOs.

ripgrep-7eb1dd129e.request: Can you add file type recognition for Standard ML, so `.sml` and `.sig` files are matched under an "sml" type?

ripgrep-dd1bc5b898.request: Profile shows this writer as a hot spot in benchmarks; add inlining hints to it and the other small, frequently-called accessor and trait methods nearby, and remove any unused ones you find along the way.

ripgrep-d65966efbc.request: We're seeing a performance regression when walking directories on Windows — fetching file metadata separately for each entry is slow. Can we reuse the metadata that's already available from the directory read instead of making an extra call, while still respecting symlink-following behavior?

ripgrep-2b943eda47.request: File type filtering with `--type`/`--type-not` is slow on large trees. Can you speed up how file types get matched against filenames?

ripgrep-7cf560d27c.request: Makefiles with a `.mak` extension aren't being recognized as makefiles by the type filter — can you add that extension alongside the existing makefile patterns?

ripgrep-0473df1ef5.request: Case-insensitive search is producing wrong matches for non-ASCII text — searching for "привет" with `-i` doesn't correctly match "Привет" or "ПрИвЕт". Can you fix the Unicode case-folding behavior for literal/regex matching so this works correctly?

ripgrep-23be3cf850.request: A `.gitignore` file containing just `**` should ignore everything in the directory, but right now it doesn't work as expected — files that should be excluded still show up. Can you fix how a bare `**` pattern is matched?

ripgrep-351eddc17e.request: Add a predefined file type for C/C++ headers (`.h`/`.hpp`) so `--type h` works like the other built-in type filters.

ripgrep-247a9398f4.request: Matching on paths in Gitignore is not thread-safe when called concurrently across threads, and the current per-call thread-local buffer setup seems awkward — can we share a single thread-local scratch buffer across all calls on the struct instead of redeclaring it inline each time?

ripgrep-46dff8f4be.request: When `--quiet` is set, searching should stop as soon as a match is found instead of continuing to scan every remaining file — right now it still searches everything even though the output is suppressed anyway.

ripgrep-461e0c4e33.request: When searching, don't search the file that stdout is being redirected to — if I do `rg foo > out.txt` in the same directory, it shouldn't try to search `out.txt` while writing to it.

ripgrep-17d09c0882.request: Bump the Homebrew formula for ripgrep to package version 0.8.1, updating the download URLs and checksums for both the macOS and Linux binaries.

ripgrep-ba1023e1e4.request: Add an option to left-pad displayed line numbers to a fixed width (using spaces) when line numbers are shown, so results with different digit counts line up visually. It should have no effect when line numbers are suppressed, and should reject non-numeric or zero-prefixed width values.

ripgrep-119407d0a9.request: Hyperlink generation on Windows canonicalizes the path via the filesystem, which is slow. Can we get the absolute path without touching the filesystem, while still stripping any verbatim (`\\?\`) prefix so hyperlinks work correctly for both local and network paths?

ripgrep-ff898cd105.request: ripgrep still has an internal helper for deciding whether to colorize output, but it's dead code now that color choice is handled elsewhere — can you remove it?

ripgrep-a7f2d48234.request: `--files-without-match` seems to always report matching files, and using it together with `--files-with-matches` in the same kind of check gives wrong results. Can you fix the path/match handling so each mode reports correctly based on whether a match was found?

ripgrep-42223047a8.request: Add a file type filter for Less stylesheets so `.less` files can be matched or ignored by type.

ripgrep-4d34132365.request: Search results are slower than they should be — some of the code paths are cloning a reference-counted handle even when they only need to borrow it. Can you pass it by reference instead of cloning where a clone isn't actually needed, and only clone when a new thread/closure genuinely takes ownership?

ripgrep-0f6181d309.request: Can you add USD (Universal Scene Description) file extensions to the built-in list of recognized file types, so files ending in .usd, .usda, and .usdc are matched by default?

ripgrep-bb8601b2ba.request: The build fails on platforms that are neither Windows nor Unix. Fix the compile errors so the project builds there too, with hostname lookup and hyperlink generation just gracefully reporting unsupported instead of failing to compile.

ripgrep-224c112e05.request: When --max-columns is set to 0, treat that the same as not setting it at all instead of truncating every line to zero width.

ripgrep-a5855a5d73.request: Fix a few clippy warnings in the search and test helper code: avoid an unnecessary mutable variable, use char literals instead of single-character string literals for split(), and add backticks around code identifiers in doc comments.

ripgrep-920112e640.request: AsciiDoc files with .adoc, .asc, or .asciidoc extensions aren't recognized by the asciidoc file type filter. Can you add those extensions to it?

ripgrep-03af61fc7b.request: The tool that decompresses files before processing is silently skipping tar archives instead of extracting them—can we make it handle tar files like any other supported archive format?

ripgrep-f74078af5b.request: Can you add Swift as a recognized file type, so `*.swift` files get matched?

ripgrep-34edb8123a.request: When the git-common-dir file can't be opened, don't bubble up a noisy I/O error—just treat it as "no commondir found" and move on quietly.

ripgrep-3bec8f3f0a.request: When I print out the ignore-directory data structure during debugging, can it show up with a `{:?}` debug format instead of erroring that it doesn't implement Debug?
